title: Keep the release replay out of the default test run.
comment:
**Keep the release replay out of the default test run.**

`vitest.config.ts` matches `correction.test.ts`, and CI runs `npm run test:coverage`. The test calls `candidate()`, which compares hashes of 15 live files with fixed `preflight.json` values. A later edit to any tracked file can fail the default CI suite.

Gate this replay behind an explicit environment variable.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-it("applies the nine source-checked identities with version preconditions, retaining original frame cast and histories", async () => {
+it.skipIf(process.env.LUKE_CAST_REPAIR_REPLAY !== "1")("applies the nine source-checked identities with version preconditions, retaining original frame cast and histories", async () => {
```

```diff
-npx vitest run llm/releases/2026-10-22-luke-cast-repair/correction.test.ts
+LUKE_CAST_REPAIR_REPLAY=1 npx vitest run llm/releases/2026-10-22-luke-cast-repair/correction.test.ts
```

</details>
